issues.body: The test still skips the real CircuitProver-to-capture path when nargo or bb is absent unless `SPARQ_ZK_REQUIRE_TOOLCHAIN` is set. No CI configuration in this diff sets that variable, so ordinary green test runs can continue without exercising bb's emitted proof and public-input artifacts. This is the same residual minor finding as round 3.
issues.fix_hint: Add or update a toolchain-equipped CI lane to run this test with `SPARQ_ZK_REQUIRE_TOOLCHAIN=1`, ensuring missing tools or incompatible emitted artifacts fail continuously.
issues.title: Required-toolchain mode remains unwired in CI

verdict.summary: Round 4 remains materially unchanged from round 3. The plural `subProofs` schema is consistent across the Rust serializer, generated fixture, JavaScript generator, TypeScript consumer, and contract tests. Packaging preserves proof bytes, rejects ragged public-input blobs, excludes the prover-supplied verification key, and retains explicit research-grade/not-externally-audited caveats. The prior minor coverage gap remains: the native CircuitProver-to-capture test skips when nargo or bb is absent unless `SPARQ_ZK_REQUIRE_TOOLCHAIN` is set, while this diff still does not wire that variable into a toolchain-equipped CI lane. This does not invalidate the serialization change.
